title: APU vs JBU: tuition, size, location
summary: Azusa Pacific University (APU) versus John Brown University (JBU). Also searched as JBU vs APU. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: John Brown University (JBU) and Azusa Pacific University (APU) are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their ownership codes reported by College Scorecard. JBU is located in Siloam Springs and has an undergraduate enrollment of 1,471 students, whereas APU is situated in Azusa with a larger undergraduate population of 2,759. Tuition costs also differ between the two, with JBU charging $31,756 for in-state students compared to APU's higher tuition of $44,458. These distinctions highlight differences in size, location, and cost between John Brown University vs Azusa Pacific University.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing John Brown University vs Azusa Pacific University in terms of cost, John Brown University charges $31,756 for both in-state and out-of-state tuition. In contrast, Azusa Pacific University has a higher tuition fee of $44,458 for both in-state and out-of-state students. Regarding student debt, the median debt for completers at John Brown University is $21,250, while at Azusa Pacific University, it is slightly higher at $23,219. These figures provide insight into the financial commitments associated with attending each institution.
